card.name: Linking words in antimalarial drug text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (as, with, of, or, a, the, commas) right before a malaria drug name such as quinine, artemether or mefloquine in antimalarial label text. Also fires on 'Hun' in 'Prime Minister Hun Sen'.

modes.label: Linking word before antimalarial
modes.description: A small word like 'as', 'of' or 'or' that comes just before an antimalarial drug name.
modes.example: Drugs that prolong the QT interval, including antimalarials such<< as>> quinine and quinidine, should

modes.label: Hun in Hun Sen
modes.description: The name 'Hun' after 'Prime Minister' in news text about Cambodia.
modes.example: Prime Minister<< Hun>> Sen, Royal Palace Minister Kong Samol
